provenance: control/controller.py TUNED_Q_DIAG/TUNED_R_SCALE. Tuned 2026-09-22 by research/tune_gains.py on the research JS/WASM engine with the OLD selected profile (1.7117 kg), not on this aircraft or this plant.
integral_limit_note: State limit on the LQI integrals (xi_z in m*s, xi_vx in m), with integration frozen while any rotor command saturates. Class default is 5.0 (unchanged).
feedforward_note: Reference-acceleration feed-forward (configs/arena.json controllers.GSLQR.reference_feedforward = window_acceleration), standard tracking-LQR form u = u_ss - K(x - x_ss): at each schedule point the steady forward-acceleration state/input offset [dphi, dn] per 1 m/s^2 is solved from the same error-state linearization the LQR uses (velocity + angular-acceleration rows, min norm in the LQR's own weights diag(Q_phi, Q_n + R); control/controller.py::feedforward_gain) and interpolated like K. The linear offset is used only inside its validity range, found from the nominal model alone (control/controller.py::feedforward_validity: |dv_x - a| <= 0.1|a|, |dv_z| <= 0.1|a|, |dw| <= 2 rad/s^2, 0.1 m/s^2 scan; ~1.4-2.6 m/s^2 below 25 m/s, 4-8 m/s^2 above 30 m/s), beyond which the reference acceleration is clipped. a_ref is the forward difference of the reference velocity over the NMPC's first prediction interval (0.05 s) of the same window. Class default off (legacy bit-identical); a constant reference skips the path.
change_record: 2026-09-26 kj decision 6-9: the smoke run hit the 5.0 limit on xi_vx for 10.97% (mass x1.3) and 4.89% (motor tau x2) of the mission (1% rule). With the limit removed, mass x1.3 counts as 'impact' under the pre-registered rule (stop 44.33 -> 44.59 s; over the common window RMSE v 7.96 -> 7.11, z 5.17 -> 4.89; trajectories identical until 37.94 s); tau x2 shows no impact; the divergence outcome is unchanged in both. kj rule: widen if impact. 50 is the smallest candidate (5 -> 50 -> 500) that keeps every GSLQR smoke case at 0% time-at-limit (peak |xi_vx| 5.99). Made AFTER seeing smoke results, OUTSIDE the tuning budget, in GSLQR's FAVOUR (baseline-strengthening). Evidence: results/arena/INTEGRATORS_SMOKE.md. 2026-09-26 afternoon kj decision 2: reference-acceleration feed-forward (see feedforward_note), because the NMPCs see the reference 1 s ahead while GSLQR only saw the current reference (tuning ramp 0->15: GSLQR window RMSE v 0.58 vs NMPC 0.035-0.072).
